Fiscal state of a service order in Omie, as StatusOS returns it: which stage it sits in, whether it was cancelled, whether it was already invoiced and — when it was — the NFS-e that came out of it.

Fiscal state of a service order in Omie, as StatusOS returns it: which stage it sits in, whether it was cancelled, whether it was already invoiced and — when it was — the NFS-e that came out of it.

public OmieServiceOrderStatus(long OsCode, string? OsNumber, string? Stage, bool IsCancelled, bool IsInvoiced, decimal TotalValue, OmieServiceInvoiceStatus? Invoice)

Parameters

OsCode long

Omie's internal service order identifier (nCodOS).

OsNumber string

Service order number as the user sees it (cNumOS).

Stage string

Kanban stage (cEtapa).

IsCancelled bool

The service order was cancelled in Omie (cCancelada).

IsInvoiced bool

Invoicing was triggered (cFaturada) — which does not guarantee an authorized invoice.

TotalValue decimal

Service order total (nValorTot).

Invoice OmieServiceInvoiceStatus

The NFS-e/RPS of the order. Null when it was never invoiced.
